description: ECC6 classic Asset Accounting is replaced by New Asset Accounting in S/4HANA. Parallel ledgers are introduced, depreciation areas are restructured, and asset postings move from batch-based month-end runs to real-time integration with the general ledger.
source_system_behaviour: Depreciation posted via a scheduled batch job at month-end; asset values reconciled manually against GL in a separate step; single depreciation area used for statutory reporting.
target_system_behaviour: Depreciation posts in real time on every asset transaction; GL and asset sub-ledger reconcile automatically; three depreciation areas (statutory, tax, group) run in parallel.
